candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method addFailure to class ClassRoadie
candidates.description:
Move method addFailure to org.junit.internal.runners.ClassRoadie
Rationale: While ClassRoadie is currently the class that calls addFailure, it is primarily focused on running tests rather than managing their results. Keeping the method here would dilute its responsibilities, as it would mix test execution logic with failure reporting.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method getAllArguments to class Assignments
candidates.description:
Move method getAllArguments to org.junit.experimental.theories.internal.Assignments
Rationale: The method getAllArguments() is primarily concerned with retrieving actual values from a list of assigned parameters, which is a core responsibility of the Assignments class. The method utilizes the getActualValues() method of the Assignments class, indicating that it directly interacts with the internal state of Assignments. Moving getAllArguments() to the Assignments class will enhance cohesion, as it will keep related functionality together, thereby improving maintainability and clarity of the code.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method getArgumentStrings to class Assignments
candidates.description:
Move method getArgumentStrings to org.junit.experimental.theories.internal.Assignments
Rationale: The method getArgumentStrings() is designed to retrieve a list of descriptions from the assigned potential assignments. Since this method operates directly on the 'fAssigned' field of the Assignments class, which is a collection of PotentialAssignment objects, it logically belongs within the Assignments class. Moving this method to Assignments enhances cohesion by keeping related functionality together, specifically the management and retrieval of assignment-related data. Additionally, it avoids potential confusion about the method's purpose and usage, as it directly relates to the state and behavior of the Assignments class.
